meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 Emacs 直连 AI 助手,对话无需离开编辑器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果离不开 Emacs,想在编辑器里随时向 AI 提问。
copy.tagline_en: Chat with your AI assistant right inside Emacs without switching tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you live in Emacs and want AI help without leaving your editor.

howto.what: 装上后,Emacs 会变成助手的本地对话入口:聊天缓冲里发送的消息会收到回复,回复以 org-mode 格式显示;通过 org 集成发送选区或子树时,回复会作为子标题插回当前文档。
howto.when: 启用 Emacs 渠道后,当你在 Emacs 打开聊天缓冲并发送消息,或在 org 文件里用 org-send 发送当前区域/子树时触发。

say.text: 解释一下这个函数为什么会报错,并给出修复建议。
say.note: 在聊天缓冲按 C-c C-c 发送,回复会回到 Emacs。

say.text: 审查这段选中的代码,指出问题和改进点。
say.note: 用 org-send 发送选区,回复作为子标题插入。

say.text: 把这段会议记录整理成待办行动项。
say.note: 发送 Org 子树后,回复以子标题写回文档。

howto.what_en: Installed, Emacs becomes a local channel: chat-buffer messages reach the agent and replies come back as org-mode text. Sending a region/subtree via org integration inserts the reply as a child heading.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you send a message from the Emacs chat buffer, or when you use org-send in an org file to send the current region/subtree.

say_en.text: Explain why this function fails and give a fix.
say_en.note: Send from chat buffer with C-c C-c; reply returns to Emacs.

say_en.text: Review this selected region and point out issues.
say_en.note: Org-send inserts it as a child heading.

say_en.text: Turn these meeting notes into action items.
say_en.note: Reply is added as a child heading in the file.
